Agent Introspection component: skill documents two tools that require manage_tools activation
Tools Management component: package implements manage_tools tool on top of pi runtime API
Tools UI component: user-facing /tools command on top of pi runtime API
Prompt Scheduler component: package with schedule_prompt tool, interacts with plan mode restrictions
Ask User Question component: package implements tool that uses pi events for attention management
Graphify pipeline: complete knowledge graph extraction workflow from detection through AST/semantic extraction, community detection, analysis, and multi-format exports
Pi Extension Development workflow: Archon-driven TDD process with worktree isolation, UPSTREAM.md, and npm run check gates

Graphify maintenance: add/watch for ingestion, update for incremental re-extraction, caching for performance, manifest for change detection
Graphify contract: output schema, subagent prompt rules, export formats, and ethical guidelines form the graphify ecosystem contract

nodes.label: Archon Config
nodes.description: Archon workflow configuration defining Claude as the model, worktree base branch as main, and defaults for loading default commands and workflows

nodes.label: Pi Extension Feature Workflow
nodes.description: Archon workflow for adding new pi extension packages, changing behaviour, or fixing code. Enforces git worktree isolation, TDD with vitest-first, npm run check gate, alphabetical README table, UPSTREAM.md rule, no git push, ff-only merge. Budget: 10000 tokens, 6 iterations, 900s idle timeout

nodes.label: Graphify Skill
nodes.description: Codebase knowledge graph tool that turns any folder of code/docs/papers/images/video into a navigable knowledge graph with community detection, honest audit trail, and three outputs: interactive HTML, GraphRAG-ready JSON, and GRAPH_REPORT.md. Supports Gemini and Claude subagent extraction, AST parsing, incremental updates, and exports to Neo4j/FalkorDB/GraphML/SVG/Obsidian

nodes.label: Graphify Add/Watch Reference
nodes.description: Reference documentation for /graphify add (URL ingestion) and --watch (folder watching). Supports YouTube/Twitter/arXiv/PDF/image/webpage ingestion. Watch mode triggers AST extraction for code or semantic re-extraction for docs/papers/images with debounce

nodes.label: Graphify Update Reference
nodes.description: Reference documentation for --update (incremental re-extraction) and --cluster-only (rerun clustering). --update diffs against manifest, code-only changes skip LLM, doc changes run full pipeline. --cluster-only skips extraction and re-runs community detection

nodes.label: Agent Instructions
nodes.description: Project conventions document defining scope, package manager (npm workspaces), file-scoped commands, TDD requirements, worktree workflow per issue, git workflow rules (ff-only merge, no push, no filter-branch, no placeholder git identity, no transient .md files in repo). Key rule: subagent does implementation, primary agent reviews

nodes.label: Project README
nodes.description: Main project README listing all pi-extensions packages with descriptions, links, usage commands (npm install, npm run check, npm test), and coverage threshold configuration

nodes.label: Agent Introspection Skill
nodes.description: Skill for inspecting agent session state, reading extension entries, checking token usage, listing registered slash commands, reading system prompt. Two tools: get_session_debug_info and inspect_commands. Both inactive by default, activated via manage_tools

nodes.label: Pi Ask User Question Package
nodes.description: Pi extension registering ask_user_question tool: tabbed TUI dialog for structured clarifying questions (1-5 questions, 2-6 options each). Supports single/multi-select, per-option markdown preview, free-text fallback. Emits need_user_attention/user_attention_resolved events. Ships TypeScript only via jiti runtime

nodes.label: Pi BTW Upstream
nodes.description: Port of dbachelder/pi-btw (MIT). Adds /btw side-conversation channel creating real pi sub-sessions with full tool access overlay. Supports /btw:tangent, /btw:inject, /btw:summarize, BTW-only model/thinking overrides. Last synced 742f0ee (2026-05-22)

nodes.label: Pi File System Watcher Package
nodes.description: Pi extension watching a single local filesystem path for existence, change, or removal. Polling-based (60s base, 15min cap). Fires one chat notification then marks terminal. Built on pi-watcher-core BaseWatcher. Supports add/remove/list/pause/resume/status actions. Persistence via pi.appendEntry

nodes.label: File System Watcher Skill
nodes.description: LLM-facing skill for watching local filesystem paths. Supports target conditions: exists, changed, removed. Actions: add, remove, list, pause, resume, status. Max 24h timeout. Requires activation via manage_tools. Typical use: wait for build output, detect log changes, watch directories

nodes.label: Pi Prompt Scheduler Package
nodes.description: LLM-facing scheduler for pi. schedule_prompt tool supports cron (6-field with seconds), relative time (+10s), ISO timestamp, interval duration. Two firing modes: inline (default) and subagent (with model field). Persistence in .pi/schedule-prompts.json. Session-scoped by default with recursion guard (refuses add if last 10 entries include scheduled_prompt)

nodes.label: Pi Tools Management Tool Package
nodes.description: Pi extension giving LLM a manage_tools tool (list/activate/deactivate/reset). Built on pi.getAllTools/pi.getActiveTools/pi.setActiveTools API. Auto-continue via agent_end listener firing triggerTurn. Self-protected (cannot deactivate itself). Counter cap of 3 consecutive auto-refreshes. Bypasses pi-plan-mode tool restrictions

nodes.label: Pi Tools Package
nodes.description: User-facing /tools command for reviewing and toggling tools. Shows name, source (builtin/sdk/extension/skill/unknown), active/inactive state, description, JSON schema, token estimate. Toggles via pi.setActiveTools with persistence to session. Supports /tools, /tools <name>, /tools --all

nodes.label: Custom Compaction Banner
nodes.description: Banner image for pi-custom-compaction package showing multiple document icons on the left converging via glowing cyan lines into a single translucent cyan document with the pi (π) symbol, representing the compaction of many documents into one. Dark background with text 'pi-custom-compaction' on the right

nodes.label: Manage Tools Tool
nodes.description: Core tool provided by pi-tools-management-tool extension. Actions: list (show all tools with active state), activate (enable tools), deactivate (disable tools), reset (restore session_start snapshot). Self-protected, idempotent, supports multiple tool names per call

nodes.label: Get Session Debug Info Tool
nodes.description: Tool from agent-introspection extension. Returns session metadata (ID, leaf ID, CWD, session file path), token usage, session entries grouped by customType, and full system prompt. Supports filter parameter for customType prefix filtering

nodes.label: Inspect Commands Tool
nodes.description: Tool from agent-introspection extension. Lists all registered slash commands with descriptions. Inactive by default, activated via manage_tools. Used to discover available commands in current session

nodes.label: Ask User Question Tool
nodes.description: Tool from pi-ask-user-question extension. Opens tabbed TUI dialog for structured clarifying questions. Supports single-select, multi-select, per-option markdown preview, free-text fallback. Validates arguments, rejects duplicate/reserved labels. Emits need_user_attention and user_attention_resolved events

nodes.label: Schedule Prompt Tool
nodes.description: Tool from pi-prompt-scheduler package. Actions: add, remove, list, enable, disable, update, cleanup. Supports cron (6-field), relative time, ISO timestamp, interval duration. Two firing modes: inline (default) and subagent (with model field). Includes recursion guard

nodes.label: File System Watcher Tool
nodes.description: Tool from pi-file-system-watcher extension. Actions: add (exists/changed/removed targets), remove, list, pause, resume, status. Polling-based with 60s base and 15min cap. Fires one chat notification then marks terminal. Max 24h timeout

nodes.label: Tools Command
nodes.description: User-facing slash command from pi-tools package. Interactive TUI for browsing and toggling tools. Groups by source (builtin/sdk/extension/skill/unknown). Shows token estimates. Supports /tools, /tools <name>, /tools --all with keybindings for toggle, detail view, and navigation

nodes.label: TDD Pattern
nodes.description: Test-Driven Development pattern enforced by project conventions. Failing vitest test must be written before implementation code. Tests call functions that don't exist yet. npm run check gates (tsc -b + vitest run) must pass before merge

nodes.label: Git Worktree Isolation
nodes.description: Git workflow pattern: each issue gets its own worktree named after the issue. Changes implemented inside worktree, ff-only merge from main repo. Rebase onto origin/main before merge. Health checks re-run after rebase

nodes.label: UPSTREAM.md Convention
nodes.description: Convention requiring UPSTREAM.md at package root for any copied/ported package. Records upstream repo URL, file path, commit hash + date, local divergence notes, and git log recipe for spotting future upstream changes. Not needed for originally authored packages

nodes.label: Graphify Python Backend
nodes.description: Python-based graphify tool providing AST extraction, semantic extraction via LLM (Gemini/Claude subagents), community detection, graph building, analysis (god nodes, surprising connections, suggested questions), reporting, and exports (HTML, JSON, GraphML, SVG, Neo4j, FalkorDB, Obsidian, Wiki, MCP)

nodes.label: Pi Watcher Core
nodes.description: Shared base library providing BaseWatcher abstract class. Used by file-system-watcher extension for poll-loop, persistence, state management, TUI widget, and menu. Also used by pi-aws-ec2-watcher and pi-aws-glue-watcher

nodes.label: Pi Events API
nodes.description: Pi runtime events system supporting need_user_attention, user_attention_resolved, agent_end, session_start (startup/new/resume/fork). Extensions use these events for communication and lifecycle management

nodes.label: Pi SetActiveTools API
nodes.description: Pi runtime API for managing active tools: pi.getAllTools, pi.getActiveTools, pi.setActiveTools. Used by pi-tools and pi-tools-management-tool for tool state management. Snapshot taken per agent.prompt() call

nodes.label: Pi Built-in Tools
nodes.description: Core pi tools: read, bash, edit, write, find, grep, ls. Used by AGENTS.md workflow, graphify skill, and referenced in pi-built-in-tool-renderer extension for compact custom rendering

nodes.label: Pi Plan Mode
nodes.description: Read-only exploration mode toggled via /plan, Ctrl+Alt+P, or Shift+Tab. Has bash allowlist and post-plan action prompt. Interacts with pi-tools-management-tool: LLM can bypass plan-mode tool restrictions via manage_tools

nodes.label: NPM Workspaces
nodes.description: npm workspaces monorepo setup. Commands: npm install, npm run check (typecheck + tests), npm test (vitest run). Packages in packages/ directory. TypeScript build via tsc -b. Vitest for testing with coverage thresholds

nodes.label: Archon Agent Framework
nodes.description: Agent orchestration framework used for structured development workflows. Defines interactive loops with phases: formulation, plan, implementation, adversarial review, commit. Supports worktree isolation, budget tokens, idle timeouts, and READY gates

nodes.label: Graphify Output Format
nodes.description: Structured JSON output format for graph extraction with nodes (id, label, type, description, source_location, confidence), edges (source, target, relation), and hyperedges (members, type, description). Types: Concept, Module, File, Tool, Skill, Config, Pattern, Workflow, Package, Image

nodes.label: Pi Extensions Monorepo
nodes.description: Monorepo containing all pi-agent extensions. Packages live in packages/ directory. Each package is a standalone extension loadable by pi via pi install or local path. Ships TypeScript sources loaded via jiti runtime (no separate build step)

nodes.label: Pi CMUX Notifications
nodes.description: Extension providing sidebar indicator for chat notifications. Used by watchers (file-system-watcher, aws-ec2-watcher, aws-glue-watcher) for displaying notification presence

nodes.label: Pi Session Recap
nodes.description: Package with UPSTREAM.md documenting upstream source. Referenced in AGENTS.md as example of UPSTREAM.md format

nodes.label: Pi Built-in Tool Renderer
nodes.description: Extension that re-registers built-in read/bash/edit/write/find/grep/ls tools with compact custom renderers. Ported from badlogic/pi-mono/examples/built-in-tool-renderer.ts

nodes.label: Pi Skills Browser
nodes.description: Extension for browsing available skills with TUI navigation

nodes.label: Pi Extensions Browser
nodes.description: Extension listing extension commands at project scope and user scope with name and source path

nodes.label: Pi Claude Code Import Commands
nodes.description: Extension importing Claude Code slash commands (~/.claude/commands and project-local .claude/commands) into pi as prompt templates available as /command-name

nodes.label: Pi Claude Code Skills Import
nodes.description: Extension importing Claude Code installed skills (user skills, plugin-cache skills, project-local .claude/skills) into pi via resources_discover

nodes.label: Pi AWS EC2 Watcher
nodes.description: Extension watching AWS EC2 instances by ID for state transitions with chat notification per change. Activated via manage_tools. /ec2-watcher slash command opens TUI for browse/pause/resume/start/stop

nodes.label: Pi AWS Glue Watcher
nodes.description: Extension watching AWS Glue job and workflow runs with chat notification per change. Polls GetJobRun/GetWorkflowRun on 60s to 15min back-off. Self-terminates on SUCCEEDED/FAILED/STOPPED/TIMEOUT/ERROR

nodes.label: Pi AWS S3 Watcher
nodes.description: Extension watching AWS S3 object URI for changes

nodes.label: Pi Agent Version
nodes.description: Extension providing /version slash command using import.meta.resolve + readFileSync

nodes.label: Pi Plan Mode Package
nodes.description: Read-only exploration mode toggled via /plan, Ctrl+Alt+P, or Shift+Tab, with bash allowlist and post-plan action prompt

nodes.label: Pi Speak
nodes.description: Extension providing text-to-speech capability for pi agent sessions

nodes.label: Graphify Detection Step
nodes.description: Step 2 of graphify pipeline: detect files in input path, categorize into code/docs/papers/images/video, compute word counts, skip sensitive files, rank subdirectories by file count

nodes.label: Graphify Semantic Extraction
nodes.description: Part B of graphify pipeline: parallel subagent-based semantic extraction using Gemini or Claude. Splits uncached files into chunks of 20-25, dispatches general-purpose Agent tool calls, merges results, caches, and deduplicates by node ID

nodes.label: Graphify AST Extraction
nodes.description: Part A of graphify pipeline: parses code files using graphify.llm.extract_corpus_parallel for AST extraction. Produces .graphify_ast.json with nodes and edges. Skipped if corpus is docs/papers/images only

nodes.label: Graphify Caching
nodes.description: Graphify semantic extraction cache system. Checks which files already have cached results, saves new results to cache, merges cached + new results with deduplication by node ID. Uses graphify.cache module

nodes.label: Graphify Community Detection
nodes.description: Graphify analysis step: clusters graph into communities using community detection algorithm, scores community cohesion, identifies god nodes (highly connected), surprising connections (cross-community bridges), and suggests questions

nodes.label: Graphify Exports
nodes.description: Graphify output generation: HTML visualization, GraphRAG-ready JSON, GraphML, SVG, Neo4j push, FalkorDB push, Obsidian vault, Wiki, MCP server. Each export triggered by specific CLI flag

nodes.label: Graphify Query Mode
nodes.description: Graphify query system: answers questions about the corpus using the existing graph rather than rebuilding. Supports BFS/DFS traversal modes, --budget cap, NetworkX fallback, save-result feedback. Also supports /graphify path and /graphify explain

nodes.label: Graphify Honesty Rules
nodes.description: Ethical guidelines for graphify usage: never invent an edge, never skip corpus check warning, always show token cost, never hide cohesion scores behind symbols, never run HTML viz on graph >5000 nodes without warning

nodes.label: Graphify Manifest and Cost Tracking
nodes.description: Graphify bookkeeping: saves manifest for --update mode, tracks cumulative input/output tokens across runs, stores cost.json with date-stamped run history. Cleans up temp files after each run

nodes.label: Graphify Subagent Prompt
nodes.description: Reference document for subagent extraction prompts. Contains JSON schema, node-ID rules, confidence rubric, frontmatter handling, hyperedge rules, and vision rules for image processing
